title: Coordinate flip sum identity
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $V$ be a real normed vector space, let $w_1,\ldots,w_n\in V$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. For each coordinate $i$, form the point obtained by flipping coordinate $i$ of $x$. The sum over all $i$ of the signed vector sums at these flipped points equals $(n-2)$ times the signed vector sum at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a real normed vector space
$w$ assigns a vector in $V$ to each of the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
